_description: Configuration for signing Windows AI installer with Authenticode certificate

procurement: For production releases, obtain a code signing certificate from a trusted CA:
requirements: Organization Validation (OV) or Extended Validation (EV) certificate required
EV certificates provide immediate SmartScreen reputation
OV certificates require building reputation over time
storage: Store certificates securely (never commit to version control)
Use environment variables or secure key storage for passwords
Consider using Azure Key Vault or AWS KMS for production
For CI/CD, use GitHub Secrets or similar secure storage
timestamping: Timestamp servers ensure signatures remain valid after cert expiration
Multiple timestamp servers provided as fallback options
If primary timestamp server fails, signing will fail
Consider implementing retry logic with alternate servers
